mode: DISCLOSE only (read-only pre-author; no wiring, no score move)
purpose: Instance the frozen reveal contract for C6 — sensor fault under-detection. Surfaces SensorDynamicsState gates, consumer mapping, C3 interaction, 14-case split, live FT-8 neighbours, confounders, and baseline pin.

reveal_contract_template.definition: Producer/consumer logic + thresholds derivable from the cluster research answer; provable by unit tests on synthetic vectors, with no owner data.
The per-case owner columns still required and which residual case_ids each unlocks; stays abstained until the owner supplies real measured values.
Explicit separation of producer/consumer logic shipped from top3_family delta. Landing code proves the discriminator is wired; it does not move score until gated data exists.
The neighbour set the consumer edit touches, plus the no-regressed-family audit run on the full corpus at commit time.
Cases whose discriminating signal the owner cannot supply stay abstained at MARGIN=0.02, never guessed from static idle data.

baseline.note: All C6 sizing references this current post-C3B baseline. If any commit lands first, stop and re-pin before C6-SYNTH/C6A.

c6_instance.title: sensor fault under-detection

producer.emit_condition: Emit O2_LAZY_OR_BIASED from decisive Mode $06 or active O2 response evidence; emit MAF_UNDERREAD from sustained 10-15% actual-vs-calculated shortfall at idle and 2500; emit SENSOR_HEALTH_UNPROVEN_ABSTAIN for static-only evidence.

thresholds.maneuver: Warm closed loop; retrieve Mode $06 current result and min/max limits
thresholds.threshold: Use the ECU's stored min/max acceptable band; low or exceeded margin to the vehicle-specific limit emits O2_LAZY_OR_BIASED
thresholds.cite: cluster6.md §Question One Answer lines 114-115; §Question Four Answer line 155; Candidate Signature Table line 171
thresholds.feasibility_tier: Tier A: generic OBD-II Mode $06 where exposed

thresholds.signal: Forced rich→lean / lean→rich O2 response timing
thresholds.maneuver: Stabilize at about 2500 rpm no-load; decel fuel cut for rich→lean; controlled return/enrichment for lean→rich
thresholds.threshold: Prefer vehicle Mode $06/OEM limit; absent that, longer-than-expected transition is positive evidence. Research names the direction, not a fleet-wide millisecond fail line; 849 ms / <150 ms examples must not be treated as universal.
thresholds.cite: cluster6.md §Question Three Answer lines 147-151; §Question Four Answer line 157; Candidate Signature Table line 172
thresholds.grounding: manufacturer-typical (direction strong, universal ms bound weak)
thresholds.feasibility_tier: Tier A if ECU monitor decisive; Tier C if scope timing required

thresholds.signal: MAF actual vs calculated airflow plausibility
thresholds.maneuver: Warm idle and steady 2500 rpm no-load; compare measured MAF to modeled airflow
thresholds.threshold: Sustained measured-MAF shortfall greater than roughly 10-15% versus modeled airflow at BOTH points emits MAF_UNDERREAD
thresholds.evidence_fields: maf_actual_calc_delta_pct_idle, maf_actual_calc_delta_pct_2500, maf_gps_idle, maf_gps_2500, calc_airflow_gps_idle, calc_airflow_gps_2500
thresholds.cite: cluster6.md §Question One Answer lines 117-118; §Question Three Answer line 149; §Question Four Answer line 161; Candidate Signature Table line 174
thresholds.grounding: empirical-inferred (component accuracy anchored; vehicle threshold provisional)
thresholds.feasibility_tier: Tier A if PID set available; otherwise Tier C modeled-airflow support

thresholds.maneuver: Single static O2 voltage, AFR, or MAF value only
thresholds.threshold: Static-only values are rejected as a separator; emit SENSOR_HEALTH_UNPROVEN_ABSTAIN
thresholds.evidence_fields: absence of decisive dynamic Mode $06/O2 timing/MAF plausibility evidence
thresholds.cite: cluster6.md §Question One Answer lines 126-129; V3_SIGNAL_ACQUISITION_SPEC_2026-07-01.md §C6.6 line 93

sensor_fault.reads: SF-005/SF-008 consume dynamic O2/MAF evidence; SF-001/SF-002 consume bias/perception fields and must obey C3 interaction precedence.

no_fault.reads: Healthy-vs-under-detected split reads decisive no-fault evidence: wide Mode $06 margin, normal response timing, and no sustained MAF shortfall.

c3_interaction.live_c3_effect: integration_shim.py::_score_rule lines 562-569 boosts EF-001/002/003 by +0.10 and prunes SF-001/SF-002 when CONTROL_REFERENCE_FAULT is present.
c3_interaction.c6_future_effect: C6 will boost sensor/no-fault consumers from SensorDynamicsState: O2_LAZY_OR_BIASED, MAF_UNDERREAD, or SENSOR_HEALTH_UNPROVEN_ABSTAIN.
c3_interaction.column_population_today: C3 columns and C6 columns are disjoint in the current corpus.
c3_interaction.required_precedence_for_c6b: If a future row carries both C3 control-reference columns and C6 sensor-dynamics columns, C3 control-reference pruning must run first for SF-001/SF-002. Only a decisive C6 dynamic sensor fault may re-enable/boost sensor rules; static-only C6 evidence must preserve abstain/prune behavior. This prevents a control-reference fault from being relabelled as a lazy O2 sensor.

case_split.note: All 14 C6 rows are SCORING_GATED. The producer/consumer logic is buildable from research, but the top3_family delta is unknowable until Mode $06/O2 timing/MAF plausibility values exist.

ft8_neighbours.risk_note: NF rules touch healthy/no-fault cases. A false C6 boost that regresses NF-001/NF-002 is high-cost because it turns a healthy case into a fault.

confounders.confounder: Upstream exhaust leak or intake tract disconnection
confounders.mechanism: Cluster6 pre-gate requires no obvious upstream exhaust leak or intake tract disconnection. Either can distort O2 or airflow plausibility and mimic lazy-O2/MAF-underread behavior.
If no MAF is fitted, the MAF_UNDERREAD branch is not applicable; the case needs O2 dynamics or abstain, not an invented MAF comparison.
confounders.cite: cluster6.md §Question Three Answer line 145 and flow lines 215-220

confounders.mechanism: If the upstream sensor is wideband, cross-count logic is not applicable; Mode $06/OEM limits or appropriate active dynamics must drive the decision.

C4 consumes these same C6 O2/MAF dynamics columns to separate exhaust leak, true lean, and biased-O2 lookalikes. C6-SYNTH must mark cases outside sensor/no-fault separability as stay-abstained candidates.
